transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, I guess the main reason I'm here is that I've just stopped caring about everything I used to look forward to. 

My fishing gear is still sitting untouched out in the garage. Going out to the woodshop just feels like a chore now. And... even when my kids try to get me to play chess with them, I'm really just going through the motions. I just don't have any interest in things right now.
About how long have you been feeling this lack of interest?

It's been... about a year and seven months now. Yeah, going on a year and seven months. That's when my wife started having some health problems, and it just kind of changed everything at home. It's really been going on since then.
Along with this lack of interest, have you also been feeling down, sad, or depressed most days?

I wouldn't really say I feel sad, no. Um... it's not like I'm sitting around crying or feeling down, exactly. I just... I don't really feel much of anything. It's more just that lack of caring I mentioned. But no, I haven't really noticed feeling sad or depressed.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy levels, like feeling constantly tired or fatigued?

Yeah, definitely. I'm just exhausted all the time. I mean, by midmorning, I feel like I’ve already worked a full shift. Being out on the site... just walking the project or climbing stairs with the crew, it honestly feels like my body is carrying wet concrete. I just have no energy at all.
How has your sleep been during this time?

It hasn't been good. Even though I get into bed completely exhausted, I either just lie there running through all our bills and the project schedules in my head... or I end up waking up around three or four in the morning. And once I'm awake, that's it. I just stare at the ceiling until it’s time to get up and drive to the site.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt unusually energized, wired, or on top of the world, needing much less sleep than usual?

No, I can't say I've ever felt like that. I mean, there are times when a project is wrapping up and we're pushing hard to meet a deadline where I might run on less sleep, but that's just the job. It's not because I feel wired or... or unusually energized. I've never felt on top of the world like you're describing. Usually, I'm just trying to get through the day.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight over this past year or so?

Yeah, my appetite is... it's pretty much gone. Most days, food just tastes like cardboard to me. I'll usually just skip breakfast entirely, and... even if I've been out on the job site all day, I just kind of pick at my dinner. I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything, but I've noticed I've had to bring my work belt in a couple of notches lately.
Have you ever experienced a period like this before in your life, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

I don't think so. I mean, I've had stressful times before, you know, when the housing market took a hit or when a big job went south. But I always bounced back. I kept working, kept eating... I could still sleep. This is different. I've never felt this... this dragged down before. It's definitely the first time it's been like this.
